purpose: Test whether downstream post-stroke outcome labels and risk estimates are materially equivalent after PCORnet-to-OMOP transformation, while separating outcome-event transformation from previously observed phenotype-cohort attrition.

index_phenotype.name: Stage C D0 ischemic-stroke index cohort
index_phenotype.inheritance_rule: Stage D must reproduce the locked Stage C D0 rules exactly and may not redefine diagnosis codes, PDX, encounter type, overnight rule, index ordering, age rule, or patient linkage.
index_phenotype.source_rule_summary: Locked explicit stroke ICD list; PDX=P; ENC_TYPE in {EI,IP}; ADMIT_DATE and DISCHARGE_DATE differ by at least one calendar day; first qualifying encounter per patient; adult rule applied after index selection.
index_phenotype.primary_omop_index: lineage-faithful D0 from the frozen ETL
index_phenotype.native_omop_index: not a primary Stage D analytical-equivalence cohort; native portability remains a Stage C sensitivity

primary.name: 90-day acute-care reutilization
primary.window: day 1 through day 90 after index discharge, inclusive
primary.pcornet_event: first subsequent PCORnet ENCOUNTER with ENC_TYPE in {ED,EI,IP}
primary.omop_event: first subsequent visit_occurrence with visit_concept_id in the frozen ED/EI/IP visit concept set, using visit_start_date
primary.observability: require source ENROLLMENT / target observation_period to cover index discharge through day 90
primary.same_day_policy: encounters or visits beginning on the index discharge date are not outcomes

secondary.name: 30-day acute-care reutilization
secondary.window: day 1 through day 30 after index discharge, inclusive
secondary.event_definition: same acute-care event definition as the primary outcome
secondary.observability: require continuous representation-specific coverage through day 30

exploratory_epidemiologic.name: hospitalized recurrent ischemic stroke
exploratory_epidemiologic.window: days 31 through 365 after index discharge, inclusive
exploratory_epidemiologic.event_definition: subsequent acute-care encounter/visit satisfying the locked ischemic-stroke diagnosis definition
exploratory_epidemiologic.role: secondary epidemiologic reproducibility only; not a prediction endpoint
exploratory_epidemiologic.observability: require continuous representation-specific coverage through day 365

primary_fixed_index_outcome_fidelity.population: patients shared by source D0 and lineage-faithful OMOP D0 with the same selected index date
primary_fixed_index_outcome_fidelity.purpose: Hold patient and index date fixed so differences primarily measure post-index acute-care event representation.

secondary_end_to_end_analytical_reproduc.population: independently selected source D0 and lineage-faithful OMOP D0 cohorts
secondary_end_to_end_analytical_reproduc.purpose: Measure the combined scientific consequence of phenotype transformation plus post-index outcome representation.

secondary_time_to_event.purpose: Compare time from discharge to first acute-care reutilization without fitting an exposure-effect model.
metrics: median days to event among event-positive patients
exact first-event-date agreement among patients positive in both representations

equivalence_margins.interpretation: Equivalence requires meeting the prespecified margin; a nonsignificant difference is not evidence of equivalence. Absolute and relative risk criteria are reported separately and jointly.

comparison_priority.primary: PCORnet source versus frozen validated lineage-faithful OMOP
comparison_priority.secondary: prior OMOP implementation may be added later as an implementation sensitivity but must not alter primary definitions or margins
